why: v2 (2026-10-25, after main's capture scoop-v1 showed tiny props and grey rim). Island r 4.4, layout x0.72, props x1.5, Moa 1.5 m, cottage 2.2 m (main chose option A). Grid search in node: cam y 2..10, cam z 3..14, target y -1..2.5, target z -2..2, fov 30..42, aspect 844/390, real GLB footprints from assets/room/scoop/manifest.json bbox_after. Every prop base and top must project inside |NDC| <= 0.95. A finer grid then ran around the best result.
Result: pos (0,4.75,7.25), target (0,1.75,2), fov 32, pitch 29.7 deg, vertical half-angle 16 deg.

Acceptance at 844x390 (fraction of frame height): Moa at start (0,0.43) 0.286 (>= 0.16). Props: mailbox 0.248, pinwheel 0.270, flowers 0.156/0.171/0.179, lemon-can 0.184, xylophone 0.179, cream-cloud 0.29, so the smallest is 0.156 (>= 0.12). Cottage 0.353 (target 30-35; it trades off against grass width, and the best grid point is 0.3 points over). Grass at Moa depth fills 0.852 of the width (>= 0.85). Back rim at NDC y 0.502, so the sky band is the top 25%. 34 rim points land in the bottom corners, the cream sliver. The front rim (NDC y -1.96) leaves the frame, as allowed.

The top of the frame looks 13.7 deg below the horizon, so the sky gradient is keyed to view elevation (blue from -16 deg, cream at -40 deg). Sky items sit low and behind the island so they land in the sky band: sky-island 2.2 m at (7, y -2.7, -13) projects to NDC x 0.46..0.63 and y 0.59..0.95, which is 18% of the frame height (v1 was 13%), and it stays inside at 1280x800 (x <= 0.86). Swirl-sun at (-7, y -2, -11) projects to x -0.67..-0.53 and y 0.58..0.94.
All 12 clouds sit at z <= -14 (the sky-island is at -13, the sun at -11), so a drifting cloud never covers the island, the sky-island or the sun.

Rejected: (B) cottage 2.0 m (32.5%, only 1.33x Moa). (C) cottage 3.4 m: with grass >= 85% it projects to >= 56%, and relaxing grass to 55% still gives 43%. Infeasible because grass >= 85% puts Moa within about 6.2 m of the camera and the cottage sits about 3 m deeper.

v3 friends (piyo 0.75 m, mongsil 1.0, popo 0.95, nuri 1.15) placed by an exhaustive order search over the island: footprints from manifest bbox x height, >= 0.32 m from every prop, fence post, tree, Moa start and the cream-cloud shadow, off the path, inside the rim, in frame, maximising the smallest frame share. Result: piyo (-3.15,2.45) 0.156, mongsil (-3.65,-0.9) 0.169, popo (-3.75,1.25) 0.185, nuri (1.3,-0.4) 0.202 of the frame height (>= 0.14). The right and front-centre of the island are full (can, xylophone, flowers, path), so three friends stand on the left.

v4 (main round 4: mongsil hidden by the cream-cloud, crowded left side, piyo jammed in the corner). Added a selftest gate: at 844x390 and 1280x800 every tappable's screen bbox (manifest half width/depth x height) keeps a 4% edge margin, and no nearer object covers more than 20% of it. On v3 the gate failed with 17 problems, including mongsil 53% under the cream-cloud and piyo/popo past the edge. Re-solved camera and layout jointly by simulated annealing (a /tmp script). Kept fixed: cottage (0,-2.6), path, Moa start. Hard constraints: >= 0.32 m gaps (props, friends, fence posts, trees, Moa), inside the rim, off the path, edge margin, cover <= 18%, min shares, friends 2 left (piyo, mongsil) / 2 right (popo, nuri), cream-cloud floating over the island (y 1.3..2.4), sky-island at z -16..-9 with share >= 0.16, sun at z -14..-8 with share >= 0.13, both above the back rim. Soft: cottage 30-35%, grass >= 85%, sky band. Result: pos (0,5.51,8.07), target (0,0.51,-0.9), fov 28.42.

v4 numbers at 844x390 (share of frame height): Moa 0.280, cottage 0.353, mailbox 0.257, pinwheel 0.268, flowers 0.164/0.150/0.139, lemon-can 0.157, xylophone 0.207, cream-cloud 0.262, sky-island 0.172, sun 0.167, piyo 0.145, mongsil 0.186, popo 0.179, nuri 0.205. Grass 0.854 of the width at Moa's depth; back rim NDC 0.406, so the top ~30% is sky. Screens narrower than 844/390 keep the horizontal field: vertical fov = atan(tan(fov/2) * design_aspect / aspect), 37.8 deg at 1280x800, so the island sides never leave the frame there (layout.verticalFov, the same rule in main.mjs resize).

v5 (2026-10-25, room-hub): framingProblems now counts tree canopies and fences as occluders (the sky-island sat 100% behind tree (2.2,-3.5) in v4/v5 while the gate passed). sky-island moved to (9.25,-14.4) y -3.75, the only clean sky slot. Three phase-2 props added by reviews/20261025/room/place-search/run2.mjs (one at a time against every selftest gate plus 3D air clearance: floating things never intersect a tappable or set piece and stay out of Moa's way): sky-plane h 0.75 over the right side at (2,-0.5) y 1.75 (share 0.152), berry-butterfly h 0.5 at (-2.2,2.3) y 1.8 above Piyo and clear of Moa's start box (0.126), cream-puff h 1 in the left sky (0.126). roll-snail and berry-sprout found no ground slot at min share 0.12 (ground full); the sprout waits for mission 4.

lights.why: one block for the scene lights and the cream colour gate (shade.mjs); change here, the gate re-checks the cream

look.why: Every GLB (props, friends, Moa) gets base-colour factor pi/irradiance at `normal` from the lights block (shade.mjs lightNeutralMult), plus a flat white emissive_offset equal to the 0.04 the Khronos PBR Neutral tone map subtracts (meant for a specular F0 this hemisphere-lit scene does not add), so its front face shows its own texture colour instead of 0.63x of it; colours above the tone map's 0.76 shoulder still roll off by design. Measured 2026-10-25: under these lights every Meshy texture rendered 15-40% darker than its sheet (cream-puff read dark lilac); the cream-only emissive tune had passed its gate on a stale pre-retex texture mean. Rejected: per-object per-channel calibration to the sheet mean (atlas area ratios differ from the front view: flowers and plane turned pink, scoop-v8-look/sheet-vs-room.jpg). Texture-vs-sheet distance is reported by the selftest from assets/room/scoop/look.json (tool/room_tex_means.py) to pick retex candidates, never to tint at run time.
